_comment: Sites whose current broken state is known and accepted. The audit still prints them, but they do not fail the run. If a site's state changes to anything other than the accepted value the audit fails, because a change is new information even when the new state looks better. Delete an entry once the underlying problem is actually fixed.

custom-letters-from-santa-claus.reason: Deliberately frozen. Built with placeholder phone 318-000-0000 and fails the launch checklist on purpose until the owner supplies a real number. Domain still on the old Snapps host.

millards-stucco-repair-baton-rouge.reason: Deliberately frozen. Fails the checklist on card count (source lists only two services and nothing was invented to pad it), plus an unresolved 225-vs-504 phone conflict. Domain still on the old Snapps host.

roofing-company-warren.reason: roofingcompanywarren.com lapsed and is now registered to someone else, serving an unrelated roofing company from Cloudflare. The rebuilt site has no domain.

make-your-own-crap.reason: Domain lapsed 2025-09-24. Site was built as a draft at the owner's request; not re-registered.

tow-truck-arlington.reason: towing-arlington.com lapsed. Owner undecided on re-registering.

towing-jonesboro.reason: Domain lapsed and the owner shelved the site on 2026-09-20. Not being revived.
